verdict.rationale: Exa has an agentic product, Exa Agent, that attaches external data providers through Exa Connect, so letting users plug in their own MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence only shows Exa acting as an MCP server for other clients. Nothing shows Exa Agent or the API consuming user-supplied MCP servers, and Exa Connect is limited to Exa's own premium data partners.
